title: Holonomy and deformation obstruction to proper analytic subvarieties dominating the projectivized cotangent bundle of a very general Hyperkaehler manifold
difficulty_reason: H2: Picard group zero alone does not exclude higher-codimension analytic cycles in the projectivized cotangent bundle. The author first restricts a putative dominating effective cycle with vanishing beta1 component to a Mehta-Ramanathan curve on a projective member. Symplectic algebraic holonomy keeps every symmetric power stable, and the original intersection/HP19 positivity contradiction forces beta1 nonzero there. The deformation argument then transports the hypothetical generic cycle with beta1=0, uses properness of the cycle space to keep it effective at a projective specialization, and obtains the contradiction. This coupling of projective holonomy, cohomological decomposition and proper cycle specialization is the new burden; the old2064 root bound and positive-current specialization theorem do not supply it.

editorial_notes: Keep complete original author statements/proofs, inline xy diagrams, precise hypotheses and source notation. No assistant proof completion, formula repair or independent correctness certification.
Hyperkaehler means the original simply connected compact Kaehler irreducible holomorphic symplectic manifold; no projectivity assumption is silently added to the main framework.
Use Grothendieck projectivization and the original tautological class; the symplectic form identifies tangent and cotangent projective bundles as in the source.

Old2064 H3 deformation-uniform pseudoeffective sufficiency, its cycle polynomial/root bound and full Diverio family-current specialization are reused inputs. Do not re-count the very-general converse or appendix as new primaries.

A very general K3 surface S and a very general deformation of X=S^[2] in its full21-dimensional Hyperkaehler deformation space are different scopes. The Hilbert-square locus is a20-dimensional family and carries the explicit exceptional divisor/cycle; do not transfer that cycle to every very-general deformation.
Diverio is explicitly the appendix author and Samuel Boissiere is explicitly credited Proposition6.2; neither is silently added to or removed from the two canonical main authors.

Original4.2 null-power,4.3 polynomial-variable and6.2 printed homogeneity/RR normalization observations remain literal uncounted source context. No corrected exponent, coefficients, RR formula or additional proof is supplied.
Conjecture1.2 is a conjecture. Named GO20, Demailly-Paun, Mehta-Ramanathan, Balaji-Kollar, HP19, Beauville/Fujiki/Huybrechts and Nieper inputs remain named source inputs, not new assistant theorems.

Retain both explicit genericity assumptions: Pic(X)=0 and extension of every irreducible component of the projectivized cotangent cycle space under the stated deformations. Do not replace them by Pic(X)=0 alone.

Conclusion is pi(Z) proper in X. The stronger conclusion that pi(Z) is a point in Cor3.5 additionally assumes X has no proper compact subvarieties; do not add that hypothesis to Lemma3.4 or silently assert the stronger conclusion.

The no-subvariety input fails for very general Kummer type as original Remark3.6 says. Theorem1.5 and the root reduction are retained as consequences/support of the same geometric framework, no additional IDs.
